office.title: Indiana State Senator
office.summary: Members of the Indiana Senate write and vote on state laws as part of the Indiana General Assembly. The Senate has 50 members, each representing one district for a four-year term; about half the seats are elected every two years {wiki_in_senate}.
duties: Introduces and votes on state legislation as one of the two chambers of the Indiana General Assembly {wiki_in_senate}.
Must be at least 25 years old when taking office and have lived in the district for at least a year, under Article 4 of the Indiana Constitution {wiki_in_senate}.
